query:
SELECT run_id AS "run_id!", session_id AS "session_id!"
            FROM (
                SELECT run_id, session_id
                FROM factory_step
                WHERE run_id = ANY($1)
                OFFSET 0
            ) steps
            WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION
            SELECT run_id, session_id
            FROM factory_step_used_session
            WHERE run_id = ANY($1)
